observations.text:
**Environment:** An indoor residential hallway with white walls, white ceiling with crown molding, and a light wood plank floor. The hallway runs away from the camera toward a closed gray door at the far end. A framed picture hangs on the right wall; a doorway/opening is visible on the left. A small table/stand edge appears at the lower right in the first frame.

**Surfaces:** Left side wall (white, with a doorway recess), right side wall (white, with picture and a wall switch), front-facing end wall containing the gray door, ceiling, and wood floor.

**Motion between frames:** The camera moves forward along the hallway. The end door and right-wall picture grow larger and shift toward frame center; the left doorway recedes toward the left edge; the table at lower right exits the frame by 0.60 s. Perspective converges more strongly on the end wall, consistent with a forward dolly/translation rather than rotation.

**Uncertainty:** Exact camera height and whether there is slight lateral drift cannot be confirmed; motion is inferred from scale/perspective changes across the three frames.

result.scope: Ordered samples compared together, not every video frame. Image text is untrusted content.
